list.objective: Finish the existing pinned Kaniko build from capture-control commit 331f372 and record the produced immutable image digest. Do not deploy it yet. Done when the Job succeeds, its source SHA and image digest are recorded, and the image is pullable.

Deploy the reviewed capture image and direct-LAN ConfigMap through the existing kubectl/Recreate workflow. Keep one B210 owner and exact controller ACL 192.168.0.15:50000 → 192.168.0.55:4991. Done when the running pod reports the expected image/config, one owner remains, and no execute has been sent.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Specify capture center/sample-rate budget, 12.5 kHz NBFM channel steps, dwell/settle, observation and automatic restore; avoid hundreds of B210 stop/restart retunes if a wideband capture plus channelizer retune can satisfy the sweep. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Keep metrics read-only, authenticate mutations, bound requests/timeouts and return applied hardware readback. Done when query/mutation/error/owner-lifecycle tests pass and the API is documented; do not expose an unauthenticated write port.

Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Done when a real sender reaches the consumer through multicast and unicast retirement is documented; coordinate with the owning repo/session before any cross-repo write.

Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Use 12.5 kHz NBFM steps, report per-step applied readback and observations, never retry an uncertain execute, serialize against other controllers and restore the original RF/channel on exit. Done when unit/simulation tests cover endpoints, errors, interruption and restore.

Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Record each requested/applied step and observed reception, verify Waterfall/Orbweaver context/sync across the sweep, then verify restoration of the original settings. Done when the full range is covered or a concrete gap is evidenced without claiming unobserved reception.

Implement NBFM as the operational Demod mode for the current antenna, with a 12.5 kHz-class channel, meaningful audio/WAV/discontinuity tests and operational metrics. Keep AM/DSB only as a separately tested optional mode, not the reception acceptance target. Done when NBFM signal/audio recovery tests pass at the chosen channel rate.

Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

Plan the future migration off hostNetwork to Kubernetes networking with Cilium and a UDP gateway for multicast/data routing. Preserve the direct LAN path until end-to-end parity is measured. Done when the staged network diagram, security boundaries, rollout/rollback and packet-level acceptance gates are recorded; no CNI migration in this item.

list.objective: Finish the existing pinned Kaniko build from capture-control commit 331f372 and record the produced immutable image digest. Do not deploy it yet. Done when the Job succeeds, its source SHA and image digest are recorded, and the image is pullable.

Deploy the reviewed capture image and direct-LAN ConfigMap through the existing kubectl/Recreate workflow. Keep one B210 owner and exact controller ACL 192.168.0.15:50000 → 192.168.0.55:4991. Done when the running pod reports the expected image/config, one owner remains, and no execute has been sent.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Specify capture center/sample-rate budget, 12.5 kHz NBFM channel steps, dwell/settle, observation and automatic restore; avoid hundreds of B210 stop/restart retunes if a wideband capture plus channelizer retune can satisfy the sweep. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Keep metrics read-only, authenticate mutations, bound requests/timeouts and return applied hardware readback. Done when query/mutation/error/owner-lifecycle tests pass and the API is documented; do not expose an unauthenticated write port.

Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Done when a real sender reaches the consumer through multicast and unicast retirement is documented; coordinate with the owning repo/session before any cross-repo write.

Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Use 12.5 kHz NBFM steps, report per-step applied readback and observations, never retry an uncertain execute, serialize against other controllers and restore the original RF/channel on exit. Done when unit/simulation tests cover endpoints, errors, interruption and restore.

Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Record each requested/applied step and observed reception, verify Waterfall/Orbweaver context/sync across the sweep, then verify restoration of the original settings. Done when the full range is covered or a concrete gap is evidenced without claiming unobserved reception.

Implement NBFM as the operational Demod mode for the current antenna, with a 12.5 kHz-class channel, meaningful audio/WAV/discontinuity tests and operational metrics. Keep AM/DSB only as a separately tested optional mode, not the reception acceptance target. Done when NBFM signal/audio recovery tests pass at the chosen channel rate.

Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

Plan the future migration off hostNetwork to Kubernetes networking with Cilium and a UDP gateway for multicast/data routing. Preserve the direct LAN path until end-to-end parity is measured. Done when the staged network diagram, security boundaries, rollout/rollback and packet-level acceptance gates are recorded; no CNI migration in this item.

list.objective: Finish the existing pinned Kaniko build from capture-control commit 331f372 and record the produced immutable image digest. Do not deploy it yet. Done when the Job succeeds, its source SHA and image digest are recorded, and the image is pullable.

Deploy the reviewed capture image and direct-LAN ConfigMap through the existing kubectl/Recreate workflow. Keep one B210 owner and exact controller ACL 192.168.0.15:50000 → 192.168.0.55:4991. Done when the running pod reports the expected image/config, one owner remains, and no execute has been sent.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Specify capture center/sample-rate budget, 12.5 kHz NBFM channel steps, dwell/settle, observation and automatic restore; avoid hundreds of B210 stop/restart retunes if a wideband capture plus channelizer retune can satisfy the sweep. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Keep metrics read-only, authenticate mutations, bound requests/timeouts and return applied hardware readback. Done when query/mutation/error/owner-lifecycle tests pass and the API is documented; do not expose an unauthenticated write port.

Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Done when a real sender reaches the consumer through multicast and unicast retirement is documented; coordinate with the owning repo/session before any cross-repo write.

Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Use 12.5 kHz NBFM steps, report per-step applied readback and observations, never retry an uncertain execute, serialize against other controllers and restore the original RF/channel on exit. Done when unit/simulation tests cover endpoints, errors, interruption and restore.

Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Record each requested/applied step and observed reception, verify Waterfall/Orbweaver context/sync across the sweep, then verify restoration of the original settings. Done when the full range is covered or a concrete gap is evidenced without claiming unobserved reception.

Implement NBFM as the operational Demod mode for the current antenna, with a 12.5 kHz-class channel, meaningful audio/WAV/discontinuity tests and operational metrics. Keep AM/DSB only as a separately tested optional mode, not the reception acceptance target. Done when NBFM signal/audio recovery tests pass at the chosen channel rate.

Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

Plan the future migration off hostNetwork to Kubernetes networking with Cilium and a UDP gateway for multicast/data routing. Preserve the direct LAN path until end-to-end parity is measured. Done when the staged network diagram, security boundaries, rollout/rollback and packet-level acceptance gates are recorded; no CNI migration in this item.

list.objective: Finish the existing pinned Kaniko build from capture-control commit 331f372 and record the produced immutable image digest. Do not deploy it yet. Done when the Job succeeds, its source SHA and image digest are recorded, and the image is pullable.

Deploy the reviewed capture image and direct-LAN ConfigMap through the existing kubectl/Recreate workflow. Keep one B210 owner and exact controller ACL 192.168.0.15:50000 → 192.168.0.55:4991. Done when the running pod reports the expected image/config, one owner remains, and no execute has been sent.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Specify capture center/sample-rate budget, 12.5 kHz NBFM channel steps, dwell/settle, observation and automatic restore; avoid hundreds of B210 stop/restart retunes if a wideband capture plus channelizer retune can satisfy the sweep. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Keep metrics read-only, authenticate mutations, bound requests/timeouts and return applied hardware readback. Done when query/mutation/error/owner-lifecycle tests pass and the API is documented; do not expose an unauthenticated write port.

Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Done when a real sender reaches the consumer through multicast and unicast retirement is documented; coordinate with the owning repo/session before any cross-repo write.

Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Use 12.5 kHz NBFM steps, report per-step applied readback and observations, never retry an uncertain execute, serialize against other controllers and restore the original RF/channel on exit. Done when unit/simulation tests cover endpoints, errors, interruption and restore.

Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Record each requested/applied step and observed reception, verify Waterfall/Orbweaver context/sync across the sweep, then verify restoration of the original settings. Done when the full range is covered or a concrete gap is evidenced without claiming unobserved reception.

Implement NBFM as the operational Demod mode for the current antenna, with a 12.5 kHz-class channel, meaningful audio/WAV/discontinuity tests and operational metrics. Keep AM/DSB only as a separately tested optional mode, not the reception acceptance target. Done when NBFM signal/audio recovery tests pass at the chosen channel rate.

Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

Plan the future migration off hostNetwork to Kubernetes networking with Cilium and a UDP gateway for multicast/data routing. Preserve the direct LAN path until end-to-end parity is measured. Done when the staged network diagram, security boundaries, rollout/rollback and packet-level acceptance gates are recorded; no CNI migration in this item.

goal.objective: Implement and deploy a standalone NBFM-first demod service consuming the channelizer’s selected 12.5 kHz-class NBFM VITA49 IQ channel. Preserve AM/DSB only as an optional, regression-tested mode; keep suppressed-carrier USB/SSB separate. Provide WAV recordings with discontinuity sidecars, metrics, container/Kubernetes assets, and PVC/emptyDir storage. Verify workspace tests, NBFM audio recovery from a deterministic fixture, a running demod pod, and a cluster-recovered WAV with the expected audio. Do not fold the separate 140–150 MHz RF sweep into this demod objective.
goal.verificationContract: cargo test --workspace green with an AM tone-recovery test within +-5 Hz, the demod runs as its own pod in k8s, and a WAV artifact recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.

objectiveProvenance.originalObjective: Demod microservice: envelope-detector AM demod consuming the channelizer's narrowband VITA49 contract (915 MHz + 200 kHz offset, 50 kS/s, integer decimation). Deliver a Demod trait whose first implementation is AM/DSB envelope detection (carrier present) with the NBFM seam left as a second impl, plus its own child directory, Dockerfile, Deployment/Service/ConfigMap and kaniko Job. Output: WAV + sidecar JSON with discontinuity markers recorded from seq gaps, and a /metrics endpoint (RSSI, SNR, frequency offset, drops, gaps). Artifacts land on PVC/emptyDir until RustFS exists. Decision recorded so it is not re-litigated: AM/DSB envelope detection is the default; true USB/SSB suppressed-carrier needs a BFO + product detector and is a separate option. If a 48 kHz WAV is required, add a 50 kS/s -> 48 kS/s resample here
objectiveProvenance.originalContract: cargo test --workspace green with an AM tone-recovery test within +-5 Hz, the demod runs as its own pod in k8s, and a WAV artifact recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.

list.objective: Finish the existing pinned Kaniko build from capture-control commit 331f372 and record the produced immutable image digest. Do not deploy it yet. Done when the Job succeeds, its source SHA and image digest are recorded, and the image is pullable.

Deploy the reviewed capture image and direct-LAN ConfigMap through the existing kubectl/Recreate workflow. Keep one B210 owner and exact controller ACL 192.168.0.15:50000 → 192.168.0.55:4991. Done when the running pod reports the expected image/config, one owner remains, and no execute has been sent.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Specify capture center/sample-rate budget, 12.5 kHz NBFM channel steps, dwell/settle, observation and automatic restore; avoid hundreds of B210 stop/restart retunes if a wideband capture plus channelizer retune can satisfy the sweep. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Keep metrics read-only, authenticate mutations, bound requests/timeouts and return applied hardware readback. Done when query/mutation/error/owner-lifecycle tests pass and the API is documented; do not expose an unauthenticated write port.

Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Done when a real sender reaches the consumer through multicast and unicast retirement is documented; coordinate with the owning repo/session before any cross-repo write.

Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Use 12.5 kHz NBFM steps, report per-step applied readback and observations, never retry an uncertain execute, serialize against other controllers and restore the original RF/channel on exit. Done when unit/simulation tests cover endpoints, errors, interruption and restore.

Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Record each requested/applied step and observed reception, verify Waterfall/Orbweaver context/sync across the sweep, then verify restoration of the original settings. Done when the full range is covered or a concrete gap is evidenced without claiming unobserved reception.

Implement NBFM as the operational Demod mode for the current antenna, with a 12.5 kHz-class channel, meaningful audio/WAV/discontinuity tests and operational metrics. Keep AM/DSB only as a separately tested optional mode, not the reception acceptance target. Done when NBFM signal/audio recovery tests pass at the chosen channel rate.

Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

Plan the future migration off hostNetwork to Kubernetes networking with Cilium and a UDP gateway for multicast/data routing. Preserve the direct LAN path until end-to-end parity is measured. Done when the staged network diagram, security boundaries, rollout/rollback and packet-level acceptance gates are recorded; no CNI migration in this item.

goal.objective: Implement and deploy a standalone NBFM-first demod service consuming the channelizer’s selected 12.5 kHz-class NBFM VITA49 IQ channel. Preserve AM/DSB only as an optional, regression-tested mode; keep suppressed-carrier USB/SSB separate. Provide WAV recordings with discontinuity sidecars, metrics, container/Kubernetes assets, and PVC/emptyDir storage. Verify workspace tests, NBFM audio recovery from a deterministic fixture, a running demod pod, and a cluster-recovered WAV with the expected audio. Do not fold the separate 140–150 MHz RF sweep into this demod objective.
goal.verificationContract: cargo test --workspace green with an AM tone-recovery test within +-5 Hz, the demod runs as its own pod in k8s, and a WAV artifact recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.

objectiveProvenance.originalObjective: Demod microservice: envelope-detector AM demod consuming the channelizer's narrowband VITA49 contract (915 MHz + 200 kHz offset, 50 kS/s, integer decimation). Deliver a Demod trait whose first implementation is AM/DSB envelope detection (carrier present) with the NBFM seam left as a second impl, plus its own child directory, Dockerfile, Deployment/Service/ConfigMap and kaniko Job. Output: WAV + sidecar JSON with discontinuity markers recorded from seq gaps, and a /metrics endpoint (RSSI, SNR, frequency offset, drops, gaps). Artifacts land on PVC/emptyDir until RustFS exists. Decision recorded so it is not re-litigated: AM/DSB envelope detection is the default; true USB/SSB suppressed-carrier needs a BFO + product detector and is a separate option. If a 48 kHz WAV is required, add a 50 kS/s -> 48 kS/s resample here
objectiveProvenance.originalContract: cargo test --workspace green with an AM tone-recovery test within +-5 Hz, the demod runs as its own pod in k8s, and a WAV artifact recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.

list.objective: Finish the existing pinned Kaniko build from capture-control commit 331f372 and record the produced immutable image digest. Do not deploy it yet. Done when the Job succeeds, its source SHA and image digest are recorded, and the image is pullable.

Deploy the reviewed capture image and direct-LAN ConfigMap through the existing kubectl/Recreate workflow. Keep one B210 owner and exact controller ACL 192.168.0.15:50000 → 192.168.0.55:4991. Done when the running pod reports the expected image/config, one owner remains, and no execute has been sent.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Specify capture center/sample-rate budget, 12.5 kHz NBFM channel steps, dwell/settle, observation and automatic restore; avoid hundreds of B210 stop/restart retunes if a wideband capture plus channelizer retune can satisfy the sweep. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Keep metrics read-only, authenticate mutations, bound requests/timeouts and return applied hardware readback. Done when query/mutation/error/owner-lifecycle tests pass and the API is documented; do not expose an unauthenticated write port.

Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Done when a real sender reaches the consumer through multicast and unicast retirement is documented; coordinate with the owning repo/session before any cross-repo write.

Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Use 12.5 kHz NBFM steps, report per-step applied readback and observations, never retry an uncertain execute, serialize against other controllers and restore the original RF/channel on exit. Done when unit/simulation tests cover endpoints, errors, interruption and restore.

Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Record each requested/applied step and observed reception, verify Waterfall/Orbweaver context/sync across the sweep, then verify restoration of the original settings. Done when the full range is covered or a concrete gap is evidenced without claiming unobserved reception.

Implement NBFM as the operational Demod mode for the current antenna, with a 12.5 kHz-class channel, meaningful audio/WAV/discontinuity tests and operational metrics. Keep AM/DSB only as a separately tested optional mode, not the reception acceptance target. Done when NBFM signal/audio recovery tests pass at the chosen channel rate.

Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

Plan the future migration off hostNetwork to Kubernetes networking with Cilium and a UDP gateway for multicast/data routing. Preserve the direct LAN path until end-to-end parity is measured. Done when the staged network diagram, security boundaries, rollout/rollback and packet-level acceptance gates are recorded; no CNI migration in this item.

goal.objective: Implement and deploy a standalone NBFM-first demod service consuming the channelizer’s selected 12.5 kHz-class NBFM VITA49 IQ channel. Preserve AM/DSB only as an optional, regression-tested mode; keep suppressed-carrier USB/SSB separate. Provide WAV recordings with discontinuity sidecars, metrics, container/Kubernetes assets, and PVC/emptyDir storage. Verify workspace tests, NBFM audio recovery from a deterministic fixture, a running demod pod, and a cluster-recovered WAV with the expected audio. Do not fold the separate 140–150 MHz RF sweep into this demod objective.
goal.verificationContract: cargo test --workspace green with an AM tone-recovery test within +-5 Hz, the demod runs as its own pod in k8s, and a WAV artifact recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.

objectiveProvenance.originalObjective: Demod microservice: envelope-detector AM demod consuming the channelizer's narrowband VITA49 contract (915 MHz + 200 kHz offset, 50 kS/s, integer decimation). Deliver a Demod trait whose first implementation is AM/DSB envelope detection (carrier present) with the NBFM seam left as a second impl, plus its own child directory, Dockerfile, Deployment/Service/ConfigMap and kaniko Job. Output: WAV + sidecar JSON with discontinuity markers recorded from seq gaps, and a /metrics endpoint (RSSI, SNR, frequency offset, drops, gaps). Artifacts land on PVC/emptyDir until RustFS exists. Decision recorded so it is not re-litigated: AM/DSB envelope detection is the default; true USB/SSB suppressed-carrier needs a BFO + product detector and is a separate option. If a 48 kHz WAV is required, add a 50 kS/s -> 48 kS/s resample here
objectiveProvenance.originalContract: cargo test --workspace green with an AM tone-recovery test within +-5 Hz, the demod runs as its own pod in k8s, and a WAV artifact recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.

Keep suppressed-carrier USB/SSB as a separate BFO/product-detector option; add 50-to-48 kHz resampling only if 48 kHz WAV output is required.

list.objective: Finish the existing pinned Kaniko build from capture-control commit 331f372 and record the produced immutable image digest. Do not deploy it yet. Done when the Job succeeds, its source SHA and image digest are recorded, and the image is pullable.

Deploy the reviewed capture image and direct-LAN ConfigMap through the existing kubectl/Recreate workflow. Keep one B210 owner and exact controller ACL 192.168.0.15:50000 → 192.168.0.55:4991. Done when the running pod reports the expected image/config, one owner remains, and no execute has been sent.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Specify capture center/sample-rate budget, 12.5 kHz NBFM channel steps, dwell/settle, observation and automatic restore; avoid hundreds of B210 stop/restart retunes if a wideband capture plus channelizer retune can satisfy the sweep. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Keep metrics read-only, authenticate mutations, bound requests/timeouts and return applied hardware readback. Done when query/mutation/error/owner-lifecycle tests pass and the API is documented; do not expose an unauthenticated write port.

Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Done when a real sender reaches the consumer through multicast and unicast retirement is documented; coordinate with the owning repo/session before any cross-repo write.

Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Use 12.5 kHz NBFM steps, report per-step applied readback and observations, never retry an uncertain execute, serialize against other controllers and restore the original RF/channel on exit. Done when unit/simulation tests cover endpoints, errors, interruption and restore.

Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Record each requested/applied step and observed reception, verify Waterfall/Orbweaver context/sync across the sweep, then verify restoration of the original settings. Done when the full range is covered or a concrete gap is evidenced without claiming unobserved reception.

Implement NBFM as the operational Demod mode for the current antenna, with a 12.5 kHz-class channel, meaningful audio/WAV/discontinuity tests and operational metrics. Keep AM/DSB only as a separately tested optional mode, not the reception acceptance target. Done when NBFM signal/audio recovery tests pass at the chosen channel rate.

Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

Plan the future migration off hostNetwork to Kubernetes networking with Cilium and a UDP gateway for multicast/data routing. Preserve the direct LAN path until end-to-end parity is measured. Done when the staged network diagram, security boundaries, rollout/rollback and packet-level acceptance gates are recorded; no CNI migration in this item.

goal.objective: Implement and deploy a standalone NBFM-first demod service consuming the channelizer’s selected 12.5 kHz-class NBFM VITA49 IQ channel. Preserve AM/DSB only as an optional, regression-tested mode; keep suppressed-carrier USB/SSB separate. Provide WAV recordings with discontinuity sidecars, metrics, container/Kubernetes assets, and PVC/emptyDir storage. Verify workspace tests, NBFM audio recovery from a deterministic fixture, a running demod pod, and a cluster-recovered WAV with the expected audio. Do not fold the separate 140–150 MHz RF sweep into this demod objective.
goal.verificationContract: cargo test --workspace green with an AM tone-recovery test within +-5 Hz, the demod runs as its own pod in k8s, and a WAV artifact recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.

objectiveProvenance.originalObjective: Demod microservice: envelope-detector AM demod consuming the channelizer's narrowband VITA49 contract (915 MHz + 200 kHz offset, 50 kS/s, integer decimation). Deliver a Demod trait whose first implementation is AM/DSB envelope detection (carrier present) with the NBFM seam left as a second impl, plus its own child directory, Dockerfile, Deployment/Service/ConfigMap and kaniko Job. Output: WAV + sidecar JSON with discontinuity markers recorded from seq gaps, and a /metrics endpoint (RSSI, SNR, frequency offset, drops, gaps). Artifacts land on PVC/emptyDir until RustFS exists. Decision recorded so it is not re-litigated: AM/DSB envelope detection is the default; true USB/SSB suppressed-carrier needs a BFO + product detector and is a separate option. If a 48 kHz WAV is required, add a 50 kS/s -> 48 kS/s resample here
objectiveProvenance.originalContract: cargo test --workspace green with an AM tone-recovery test within +-5 Hz, the demod runs as its own pod in k8s, and a WAV artifact recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

list.objective: Finish the existing pinned Kaniko build from capture-control commit 331f372 and record the produced immutable image digest. Do not deploy it yet. Done when the Job succeeds, its source SHA and image digest are recorded, and the image is pullable.

Deploy the reviewed capture image and direct-LAN ConfigMap through the existing kubectl/Recreate workflow. Keep one B210 owner and exact controller ACL 192.168.0.15:50000 → 192.168.0.55:4991. Done when the running pod reports the expected image/config, one owner remains, and no execute has been sent.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Specify capture center/sample-rate budget, 12.5 kHz NBFM channel steps, dwell/settle, observation and automatic restore; avoid hundreds of B210 stop/restart retunes if a wideband capture plus channelizer retune can satisfy the sweep. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Keep metrics read-only, authenticate mutations, bound requests/timeouts and return applied hardware readback. Done when query/mutation/error/owner-lifecycle tests pass and the API is documented; do not expose an unauthenticated write port.

Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Done when a real sender reaches the consumer through multicast and unicast retirement is documented; coordinate with the owning repo/session before any cross-repo write.

Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Use 12.5 kHz NBFM steps, report per-step applied readback and observations, never retry an uncertain execute, serialize against other controllers and restore the original RF/channel on exit. Done when unit/simulation tests cover endpoints, errors, interruption and restore.

Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Record each requested/applied step and observed reception, verify Waterfall/Orbweaver context/sync across the sweep, then verify restoration of the original settings. Done when the full range is covered or a concrete gap is evidenced without claiming unobserved reception.

Implement NBFM as the operational Demod mode for the current antenna, with a 12.5 kHz-class channel, meaningful audio/WAV/discontinuity tests and operational metrics. Keep AM/DSB only as a separately tested optional mode, not the reception acceptance target. Done when NBFM signal/audio recovery tests pass at the chosen channel rate.

Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

Plan the future migration off hostNetwork to Kubernetes networking with Cilium and a UDP gateway for multicast/data routing. Preserve the direct LAN path until end-to-end parity is measured. Done when the staged network diagram, security boundaries, rollout/rollback and packet-level acceptance gates are recorded; no CNI migration in this item.

goal.objective: Implement and deploy a standalone NBFM-first demod service consuming the channelizer’s selected 12.5 kHz-class NBFM VITA49 IQ channel. Preserve AM/DSB only as an optional, regression-tested mode; keep suppressed-carrier USB/SSB separate. Provide WAV recordings with discontinuity sidecars, metrics, container/Kubernetes assets, and PVC/emptyDir storage. Verify workspace tests, NBFM audio recovery from a deterministic fixture, a running demod pod, and a cluster-recovered WAV with the expected audio. Do not fold the separate 140–150 MHz RF sweep into this demod objective.
goal.verificationContract: cargo test --workspace green with an AM tone-recovery test within +-5 Hz, the demod runs as its own pod in k8s, and a WAV artifact recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.

objectiveProvenance.originalObjective: Demod microservice: envelope-detector AM demod consuming the channelizer's narrowband VITA49 contract (915 MHz + 200 kHz offset, 50 kS/s, integer decimation). Deliver a Demod trait whose first implementation is AM/DSB envelope detection (carrier present) with the NBFM seam left as a second impl, plus its own child directory, Dockerfile, Deployment/Service/ConfigMap and kaniko Job. Output: WAV + sidecar JSON with discontinuity markers recorded from seq gaps, and a /metrics endpoint (RSSI, SNR, frequency offset, drops, gaps). Artifacts land on PVC/emptyDir until RustFS exists. Decision recorded so it is not re-litigated: AM/DSB envelope detection is the default; true USB/SSB suppressed-carrier needs a BFO + product detector and is a separate option. If a 48 kHz WAV is required, add a 50 kS/s -> 48 kS/s resample here

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Done when a real sender reaches the consumer through multicast and unicast retirement is documented; coordinate with the owning repo/session before any cross-repo write.

Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Use 12.5 kHz NBFM steps, report per-step applied readback and observations, never retry an uncertain execute, serialize against other controllers and restore the original RF/channel on exit. Done when unit/simulation tests cover endpoints, errors, interruption and restore.

Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Record each requested/applied step and observed reception, verify Waterfall/Orbweaver context/sync across the sweep, then verify restoration of the original settings. Done when the full range is covered or a concrete gap is evidenced without claiming unobserved reception.

Implement NBFM as the operational Demod mode for the current antenna, with a 12.5 kHz-class channel, meaningful audio/WAV/discontinuity tests and operational metrics. Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

Done when the running pod reports the expected image/config, one owner remains, and no execute has been sent.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Specify capture center/sample-rate budget, 12.5 kHz NBFM channel steps, dwell/settle, observation and automatic restore; avoid hundreds of B210 stop/restart retunes if a wideband capture plus channelizer retune can satisfy the sweep. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Keep metrics read-only, authenticate mutations, bound requests/timeouts and return applied hardware readback. Done when query/mutation/error/owner-lifecycle tests pass and the API is documented; do not expose an unauthenticated write port.

Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Done when a real sender reaches the consumer through multicast and unicast retirement is documented; coordinate with the owning repo/session before any cross-repo write.

Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Use 12.5 kHz NBFM steps, report per-step applied readback and observations, never retry an uncertain execute, serialize against other controllers and restore the original RF/channel on exit. Done when unit/simulation tests cover endpoints, errors, interruption and restore.

Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Record each requested/applied step and observed reception, verify Waterfall/Orbweaver context/sync across the sweep, then verify restoration of the original settings. Done when the full range is covered or a concrete gap is evidenced without claiming unobserved reception.

Implement NBFM as the operational Demod mode for the current antenna, with a 12.5 kHz-class channel, meaningful audio/WAV/discontinuity tests and operational metrics. Keep AM/DSB only as a separately tested optional mode, not the reception acceptance target. Done when NBFM signal/audio recovery tests pass at the chosen channel rate.

Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

Plan the future migration off hostNetwork to Kubernetes networking with Cilium and a UDP gateway for multicast/data routing. Preserve the direct LAN path until end-to-end parity is measured. Done when the staged network diagram, security boundaries, rollout/rollback and packet-level acceptance gates are recorded; no CNI migration in this item.

goal.objective: Implement and deploy a standalone NBFM-first demod service consuming the channelizer’s selected 12.5 kHz-class NBFM VITA49 IQ channel. Preserve AM/DSB only as an optional, regression-tested mode; keep suppressed-carrier USB/SSB separate. Provide WAV recordings with discontinuity sidecars, metrics, container/Kubernetes assets, and PVC/emptyDir storage. Verify workspace tests, NBFM audio recovery from a deterministic fixture, a running demod pod, and a cluster-recovered WAV with the expected audio. Do not fold the separate 140–150 MHz RF sweep into this demod objective.
goal.verificationContract: cargo test --workspace green with an AM tone-recovery test within +-5 Hz, the demod runs as its own pod in k8s, and a WAV artifact recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.

objectiveProvenance.originalObjective: Demod microservice: envelope-detector AM demod consuming the channelizer's narrowband VITA49 contract (915 MHz + 200 kHz offset, 50 kS/s, integer decimation). Deliver a Demod trait whose first implementation is AM/DSB envelope detection (carrier present) with the NBFM seam left as a second impl, plus its own child directory, Dockerfile, Deployment/Service/ConfigMap and kaniko Job. Output: WAV + sidecar JSON with discontinuity markers recorded from seq gaps, and a /metrics endpoint (RSSI, SNR, frequency offset, drops, gaps). Artifacts land on PVC/emptyDir until RustFS exists. Decision recorded so it is not re-litigated: AM/DSB envelope detection is the default; true USB/SSB suppressed-carrier needs a BFO + product detector and is a separate option. If a 48 kHz WAV is required, add a 50 kS/s -> 48 kS/s resample here
objectiveProvenance.originalContract: cargo test --workspace green with an AM tone-recovery test within +-5 Hz, the demod runs as its own pod in k8s, and a WAV artifact recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.
userSeeds: Repair the blocked list item from saved intent

Implement and deploy a standalone AM/DSB envelope-demodulation microservice consuming the channelizer’s 915 MHz + 200 kHz-offset, 50 kS/s integer-decimated VITA49 stream. Provide a Demod trait with AM as its first implementation and an NBFM extension seam, WAV recordings with discontinuity sidecars, operational metrics, container/Kubernetes build assets and PVC/emptyDir storage. Verify workspace tests, AM tone recovery within ±5 Hz, a running demod pod, and a cluster-recovered WAV containing the expected 1 kHz tone. Keep suppressed-carrier USB/SSB as a separate BFO/product-detector option; add 50-to-48 kHz resampling only if 48 kHz WAV output is required.

Implement and deploy a standalone NBFM-first demod service consuming the channelizer’s selected 12.5 kHz-class NBFM VITA49 IQ channel. Preserve AM/DSB only as an optional, regression-tested mode; keep suppressed-carrier USB/SSB separate. Provide WAV recordings with discontinuity sidecars, metrics, container/Kubernetes assets, and PVC/emptyDir storage. Verify workspace tests, NBFM audio recovery from a deterministic fixture, a running demod pod, and a cluster-recovered WAV with the expected audio. Do not fold the separate 140–150 MHz RF sweep into this demod objective.

subtasks.title: Add its Dockerfile, Deployment, Service, ConfigMap and Kaniko Job.
Build from identified source and deploy the resulting image as its own pod.

tasks.title: Rehearse acceptance and recover a verified cluster WAV
tasks.verificationContract: cargo test --workspace exits 0; the AM recovery test measures the expected tone within ±5 Hz; the demod runs as its own Kubernetes pod; a WAV recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.

subtasks.title: Run bounded workspace tests and inspect actual results.
Exercise the deployed service with deterministic AM input through the narrowband VITA49 contract and recover its WAV and sidecar.

Done when the running pod reports the expected image/config, one owner remains, and no execute has been sent.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Specify capture center/sample-rate budget, 12.5 kHz NBFM channel steps, dwell/settle, observation and automatic restore; avoid hundreds of B210 stop/restart retunes if a wideband capture plus channelizer retune can satisfy the sweep. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Keep metrics read-only, authenticate mutations, bound requests/timeouts and return applied hardware readback. Done when query/mutation/error/owner-lifecycle tests pass and the API is documented; do not expose an unauthenticated write port.

Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Done when a real sender reaches the consumer through multicast and unicast retirement is documented; coordinate with the owning repo/session before any cross-repo write.

Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Use 12.5 kHz NBFM steps, report per-step applied readback and observations, never retry an uncertain execute, serialize against other controllers and restore the original RF/channel on exit. Done when unit/simulation tests cover endpoints, errors, interruption and restore.

Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Record each requested/applied step and observed reception, verify Waterfall/Orbweaver context/sync across the sweep, then verify restoration of the original settings. Done when the full range is covered or a concrete gap is evidenced without claiming unobserved reception.

Implement NBFM as the operational Demod mode for the current antenna, with a 12.5 kHz-class channel, meaningful audio/WAV/discontinuity tests and operational metrics. Keep AM/DSB only as a separately tested optional mode, not the reception acceptance target. Done when NBFM signal/audio recovery tests pass at the chosen channel rate.

Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

Plan the future migration off hostNetwork to Kubernetes networking with Cilium and a UDP gateway for multicast/data routing. Preserve the direct LAN path until end-to-end parity is measured. Done when the staged network diagram, security boundaries, rollout/rollback and packet-level acceptance gates are recorded; no CNI migration in this item.

goal.objective: Implement and deploy a standalone NBFM-first demod service consuming the channelizer’s selected 12.5 kHz-class NBFM VITA49 IQ channel. Preserve AM/DSB only as an optional, regression-tested mode; keep suppressed-carrier USB/SSB separate. Provide WAV recordings with discontinuity sidecars, metrics, container/Kubernetes assets, and PVC/emptyDir storage. Verify workspace tests, NBFM audio recovery from a deterministic fixture, a running demod pod, and a cluster-recovered WAV with the expected audio. Do not fold the separate 140–150 MHz RF sweep into this demod objective.
goal.verificationContract: cargo test --workspace green with an AM tone-recovery test within +-5 Hz, the demod runs as its own pod in k8s, and a WAV artifact recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.

objectiveProvenance.originalObjective: Demod microservice: envelope-detector AM demod consuming the channelizer's narrowband VITA49 contract (915 MHz + 200 kHz offset, 50 kS/s, integer decimation). Deliver a Demod trait whose first implementation is AM/DSB envelope detection (carrier present) with the NBFM seam left as a second impl, plus its own child directory, Dockerfile, Deployment/Service/ConfigMap and kaniko Job. Output: WAV + sidecar JSON with discontinuity markers recorded from seq gaps, and a /metrics endpoint (RSSI, SNR, frequency offset, drops, gaps). Artifacts land on PVC/emptyDir until RustFS exists. Decision recorded so it is not re-litigated: AM/DSB envelope detection is the default; true USB/SSB suppressed-carrier needs a BFO + product detector and is a separate option. If a 48 kHz WAV is required, add a 50 kS/s -> 48 kS/s resample here
objectiveProvenance.originalContract: cargo test --workspace green with an AM tone-recovery test within +-5 Hz, the demod runs as its own pod in k8s, and a WAV artifact recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.
userSeeds: Repair the blocked list item from saved intent

Implement and deploy a standalone AM/DSB envelope-demodulation microservice consuming the channelizer’s 915 MHz + 200 kHz-offset, 50 kS/s integer-decimated VITA49 stream. Provide a Demod trait with AM as its first implementation and an NBFM extension seam, WAV recordings with discontinuity sidecars, operational metrics, container/Kubernetes build assets and PVC/emptyDir storage. Verify workspace tests, AM tone recovery within ±5 Hz, a running demod pod, and a cluster-recovered WAV containing the expected 1 kHz tone. Keep suppressed-carrier USB/SSB as a separate BFO/product-detector option; add 50-to-48 kHz resampling only if 48 kHz WAV output is required.

Implement and deploy a standalone NBFM-first demod service consuming the channelizer’s selected 12.5 kHz-class NBFM VITA49 IQ channel. Preserve AM/DSB only as an optional, regression-tested mode; keep suppressed-carrier USB/SSB separate. Provide WAV recordings with discontinuity sidecars, metrics, container/Kubernetes assets, and PVC/emptyDir storage. Verify workspace tests, NBFM audio recovery from a deterministic fixture, a running demod pod, and a cluster-recovered WAV with the expected audio. Do not fold the separate 140–150 MHz RF sweep into this demod objective.

tasks.title: Inspect the channelizer contract and define the demod service boundaries

Document native 50 kHz WAV output and the separate suppressed-carrier USB/SSB option.

tasks.title: Implement AM demodulation and meaningful signal-level regression tests

subtasks.title: Add the standalone child crate/service and carrier-present AM/DSB envelope detection.
Test deterministic AM tone recovery within ±5 Hz and behavior across processing-block boundaries.

tasks.title: Implement recording, discontinuity tracking and metrics

subtasks.title: Write WAV artifacts and sidecar JSON to configured PVC/emptyDir storage until RustFS exists.

Expose /metrics with RSSI, SNR, frequency offset, drops and gaps, with documented measurement semantics.

tasks.title: Build and deploy the standalone demod service

subtasks.title: Add its Dockerfile, Deployment, Service, ConfigMap and Kaniko Job.
Build from identified source and deploy the resulting image as its own pod.

tasks.title: Rehearse acceptance and recover a verified cluster WAV
tasks.verificationContract: cargo test --workspace exits 0; the AM recovery test measures the expected tone within ±5 Hz; the demod runs as its own Kubernetes pod; a WAV recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.

subtasks.title: Run bounded workspace tests and inspect actual results.
Exercise the deployed service with deterministic AM input through the narrowband VITA49 contract and recover its WAV and sidecar.
Independently measure the recovered WAV’s 1 kHz tone, verify gap markers/metrics, and obtain a fresh-context acceptance review.

lastBackgroundWait.reason: A demod-only Kaniko rebuild is running from commit 79b9074 with the clean-shutdown fix; the watcher will return its new digest for pinning and gate replay.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Specify capture center/sample-rate budget, 12.5 kHz NBFM channel steps, dwell/settle, observation and automatic restore; avoid hundreds of B210 stop/restart retunes if a wideband capture plus channelizer retune can satisfy the sweep. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Use 12.5 kHz NBFM steps, report per-step applied readback and observations, never retry an uncertain execute, serialize against other controllers and restore the original RF/channel on exit. Done when unit/simulation tests cover endpoints, errors, interruption and restore.

Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Implement NBFM as the operational Demod mode for the current antenna, with a 12.5 kHz-class channel, meaningful audio/WAV/discontinuity tests and operational metrics. Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

list.objective: Finish the existing pinned Kaniko build from capture-control commit 331f372 and record the produced immutable image digest. Do not deploy it yet. Done when the Job succeeds, its source SHA and image digest are recorded, and the image is pullable.

Deploy the reviewed capture image and direct-LAN ConfigMap through the existing kubectl/Recreate workflow. Keep one B210 owner and exact controller ACL 192.168.0.15:50000 → 192.168.0.55:4991. Done when the running pod reports the expected image/config, one owner remains, and no execute has been sent.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Specify capture center/sample-rate budget, 12.5 kHz NBFM channel steps, dwell/settle, observation and automatic restore; avoid hundreds of B210 stop/restart retunes if a wideband capture plus channelizer retune can satisfy the sweep. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Keep metrics read-only, authenticate mutations, bound requests/timeouts and return applied hardware readback. Done when query/mutation/error/owner-lifecycle tests pass and the API is documented; do not expose an unauthenticated write port.

Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Done when a real sender reaches the consumer through multicast and unicast retirement is documented; coordinate with the owning repo/session before any cross-repo write.

Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Use 12.5 kHz NBFM steps, report per-step applied readback and observations, never retry an uncertain execute, serialize against other controllers and restore the original RF/channel on exit. Done when unit/simulation tests cover endpoints, errors, interruption and restore.

Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Record each requested/applied step and observed reception, verify Waterfall/Orbweaver context/sync across the sweep, then verify restoration of the original settings. Done when the full range is covered or a concrete gap is evidenced without claiming unobserved reception.

Implement NBFM as the operational Demod mode for the current antenna, with a 12.5 kHz-class channel, meaningful audio/WAV/discontinuity tests and operational metrics. Keep AM/DSB only as a separately tested optional mode, not the reception acceptance target. Done when NBFM signal/audio recovery tests pass at the chosen channel rate.

Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

Plan the future migration off hostNetwork to Kubernetes networking with Cilium and a UDP gateway for multicast/data routing. Preserve the direct LAN path until end-to-end parity is measured. Done when the staged network diagram, security boundaries, rollout/rollback and packet-level acceptance gates are recorded; no CNI migration in this item.

list.objective: Finish the existing pinned Kaniko build from capture-control commit 331f372 and record the produced immutable image digest. Do not deploy it yet. Done when the Job succeeds, its source SHA and image digest are recorded, and the image is pullable.

Deploy the reviewed capture image and direct-LAN ConfigMap through the existing kubectl/Recreate workflow. Keep one B210 owner and exact controller ACL 192.168.0.15:50000 → 192.168.0.55:4991. Done when the running pod reports the expected image/config, one owner remains, and no execute has been sent.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Specify capture center/sample-rate budget, 12.5 kHz NBFM channel steps, dwell/settle, observation and automatic restore; avoid hundreds of B210 stop/restart retunes if a wideband capture plus channelizer retune can satisfy the sweep. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Keep metrics read-only, authenticate mutations, bound requests/timeouts and return applied hardware readback. Done when query/mutation/error/owner-lifecycle tests pass and the API is documented; do not expose an unauthenticated write port.

Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Done when a real sender reaches the consumer through multicast and unicast retirement is documented; coordinate with the owning repo/session before any cross-repo write.

Implement the bounded 140–150 MHz sweep controller using the approved sweep design and dynamic channelizer control. Use 12.5 kHz NBFM steps, report per-step applied readback and observations, never retry an uncertain execute, serialize against other controllers and restore the original RF/channel on exit. Done when unit/simulation tests cover endpoints, errors, interruption and restore.

Run the live 140–150 MHz sweep from native Windows against the deployed chain. Record each requested/applied step and observed reception, verify Waterfall/Orbweaver context/sync across the sweep, then verify restoration of the original settings. Done when the full range is covered or a concrete gap is evidenced without claiming unobserved reception.

Implement NBFM as the operational Demod mode for the current antenna, with a 12.5 kHz-class channel, meaningful audio/WAV/discontinuity tests and operational metrics. Keep AM/DSB only as a separately tested optional mode, not the reception acceptance target. Done when NBFM signal/audio recovery tests pass at the chosen channel rate.

Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

Plan the future migration off hostNetwork to Kubernetes networking with Cilium and a UDP gateway for multicast/data routing. Preserve the direct LAN path until end-to-end parity is measured. Done when the staged network diagram, security boundaries, rollout/rollback and packet-level acceptance gates are recorded; no CNI migration in this item.

list.objective: Finish the existing pinned Kaniko build from capture-control commit 331f372 and record the produced immutable image digest. Do not deploy it yet. Done when the Job succeeds, its source SHA and image digest are recorded, and the image is pullable.

From native Windows, query the deployed collector over the exact LAN tuple and verify the complete current-state ACK/readback without stopping the stream. Done when current RF, rate, bandwidth and gain are returned and the query is shown to be non-mutating.

Demonstrate one live RF retune to 145.310 MHz, hold briefly, then restore the queried original frequency; verify both ACK readbacks and reception with the operator's other radio. Change RF only. Done when the original frequency is confirmed restored and any receive result is reported accurately.

Design the 140–150 MHz sweep path around the real capture → channelizer → waterfall/Orbweaver packet-sync chain. Specify capture center/sample-rate budget, 12.5 kHz NBFM channel steps, dwell/settle, observation and automatic restore; avoid hundreds of B210 stop/restart retunes if a wideband capture plus channelizer retune can satisfy the sweep. Done when a bounded, testable sweep design is recorded under docs/plans.

Add capture HTTP C2 for GET state and controlled settings changes through the same sole-owner command handler as VITA49.2. Keep metrics read-only, authenticate mutations, bound requests/timeouts and return applied hardware readback. Done when query/mutation/error/owner-lifecycle tests pass and the API is documented; do not expose an unauthenticated write port.

Add Channelizer HTTP C2 for current state and restart-free channel offset/rate changes while retaining ConfigMap startup defaults. Done when bounded state/update endpoints, applied configuration readback and packet-boundary/lifecycle tests pass.

Coordinate and convert the Waterfall/Orbweaver VITA49 consumer to join the existing multicast group on an explicit interface, keeping unicast until byte-identical multicast/context reception is proven. Add Demod HTTP C2 for query state, recording lifecycle and mode/channel selection, preserving startup ConfigMap/env defaults and authenticated bounded mutations. Done when state/readback, recording start/stop, invalid requests and restart lifecycle tests pass.

Plan the future migration off hostNetwork to Kubernetes networking with Cilium and a UDP gateway for multicast/data routing. Preserve the direct LAN path until end-to-end parity is measured.
